name: SM80 fast-F32 warp tile policy
summary: Map FP32 warp tiles onto TF32 Tensor Core instructions with configurable decomposition and accumulation behavior.

strategy.intent: Construct a legal and performance-relevant GEMM tile mapping for the target architecture.
strategy.mechanism: Decompose FP32 fragments into Tensor Core-compatible components within a warp-level tiled MMA.
strategy.expected_benefit: Exposes data reuse and parallel Tensor Core work while respecting layout and resource limits.
tradeoffs: Tile choices change shared-memory use, register pressure, occupancy, and available grid parallelism.

parameters.name: warp_shape
parameters.description: Tunable or derived tile property: warp_shape.

parameters.name: instruction_shape
parameters.description: Tunable or derived tile property: instruction_shape.

parameters.name: rounding
parameters.description: Tunable or derived tile property: rounding.

constraints.expression: warp tile is divisible by instruction tile
constraints.rationale: Every warp fragment must be covered.

constraints.expression: FP32 inputs admit the selected TF32 policy

references.evidence: The referenced CUTLASS builder/core expression implements this tile decision.
